news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.2x net interest cover). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 1% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 13% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Danube Industries Limited (BSE:540361) proposed to acquire 51% stake in Jcr Fashion Retail Private Limited.
news.body:
Danube Industries Limited (BSE:540361) proposed to acquire 51% stake in Jcr Fashion Retail Private Limited on December 11, 2025. A cash consideration will be paid by Danube Industries Limited. As part of consideration, an undisclosed value is paid towards common equity of Jcr Fashion Retail Private Limited.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by Danube Industries board and consummation of due diligence investigation. The deal has been approved by the board. The expected completion of the transaction is 9 months.
